natural: a heart of stone and guts of wood

meaning.en: Utterly unfeeling; not moved by any plea or sorrow.
meaning.zh: 心像石头，肠像木头，形容冷酷无情，不为所动。

examples.zh: 面对乞讨的孩子，他竟石心木肠，转身就走。
examples.en: Faced with a begging child, he turned and walked off with a heart of stone.

examples.zh: 再石心木肠的人，听了这个故事也会落泪。
examples.en: Even the hardest-hearted would weep at this story.

examples.zh: 她说他石心木肠，从不理会别人的苦衷。
examples.en: She says he is a stone-hearted man who never heeds anyone's troubles.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; strongly critical. Less common than 铁石心肠.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，批评意味强；不如“铁石心肠”常用。

natural: live off the enemy's grain

meaning.en: To feed one's army from the enemy's supplies.
meaning.zh: 军队的粮食取自敌方，不从本国远道运送。

equivalents: feed an army on enemy supplies

examples.zh: 孙子主张因粮于敌，以减轻本国的运输负担。
examples.en: Sun Zi advised feeding an army on enemy grain to lighten the burden of transport.

examples.zh: 远征军因粮于敌，攻下一城便补给一次。
examples.en: The expeditionary army lived off enemy grain, resupplying with each town it took.

examples.zh: 这家公司因粮于敌，利用对手的渠道推广产品。
examples.en: The firm uses its rival's channels to promote its goods, feeding off the competition.

story.en: Sun Zi teaches that a wise general 'feeds on the enemy's grain' (因粮于敌), since one bushel of enemy food is worth twenty of his own, shipped from afar.
story.zh: 孙子说：“善用兵者……取用于国，因粮于敌，故军食可足也。”

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前5世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 5th c. BC

usage.en: Predicate; a military term, occasionally used figuratively in business.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，军事用语，偶尔比喻商战。

literal: poor · yet · delight in · the Way
natural: poor yet delighting in the Way

meaning.en: To be content in poverty because one delights in principle and learning.
meaning.zh: 虽然贫穷，却以修养和道义为乐。

examples.zh: 颜回贫而乐道，一箪食一瓢饮也不改其乐。
examples.en: Yan Hui was poor yet delighted in the Way, never losing his joy over a bowl of rice and a gourd of water.

examples.zh: 这位老教授贫而乐道，一生与书为伴。
examples.en: The old professor, poor but content, kept company with books all his life.

examples.zh: 他一生贫而乐道，品格令人敬佩。
examples.en: He is content with poverty, and his poor-but-happy character is admirable.

usage.en: Predicate; often paired with 富而好礼. The Analects wording is 贫而乐 (《论语·学而》); 贫而乐道 is the fuller form found in later texts.
usage.zh: 常与“富而好礼”对举。《论语·学而》作“贫而乐”，“贫而乐道”是后世较完整的说法。

pinyin: chū bì gào, fǎn bì miàn
literal: go out · must · tell, return · must · show face
natural: tell them when you leave, show your face when you return

meaning.en: A dutiful child tells his parents when leaving and reports to them on returning.
meaning.zh: 子女外出要告知父母，回来要当面向父母报到。

equivalents: let your parents know where you are
report in when you leave and return

examples.zh: 古人讲出必告，反必面，让父母放心。
examples.en: The ancients said to tell your parents when you go out and greet them on return, to set their minds at ease.

examples.zh: 出必告，反必面，是对长辈起码的尊重。
examples.en: Telling them when you go and showing your face on return is the minimum respect owed to elders.

examples.zh: 妈妈要求孩子出必告，反必面，晚归要打电话。
examples.en: Mum asks her children to say when they go out and report back, and to phone if they're late.

story.en: Rules for a son: 'When he goes out he must tell, when he returns he must show his face; where he roams must be regular, and what he studies must have a purpose' (出必告，反必面，所游必有常，所习必有业).
story.zh: “夫为人子者，出必告，反必面，所游必有常，所习必有业。”

usage.en: Quoted in discussions of filial piety and family rules. Often followed by 所游必有常 (have a regular place to go).
usage.zh: 常用于谈孝道和家规，后接“所游必有常”。

natural: the six senses unclean

meaning.en: Not free from worldly desires; also, jokingly, still full of earthly temptations.
meaning.zh: 指不能摆脱尘世欲念；也戏指凡心未断。

examples.zh: 他整天想着吃喝玩乐，六根不净，怎么出家？
examples.en: Thinking all day of food and fun, his desires are far too strong; how could he become a monk?

examples.zh: 和尚犯戒，被说成六根不净。
examples.en: The monk who broke his vows was said to be unable to shake off worldly desires.

examples.zh: 我六根不净，一看到美食就走不动道。
examples.en: My senses are far from pure; I can't walk past good food.

usage.en: Buddhist term: the 六根 are eye, ear, nose, tongue, body and mind. Used in religious contexts and jokingly in daily speech.
usage.zh: 佛教用语：六根指眼、耳、鼻、舌、身、意。用于宗教语境，日常也可戏用。

natural: sleeping among flowers, lodging among willows

meaning.en: To visit brothels and pursue loose pleasures.
meaning.zh: 指嫖妓，流连于风月场所。

examples.zh: 他早年眠花宿柳，把家产都败光了。
examples.en: In his youth he frequented brothels and squandered his inheritance.

examples.zh: 旧小说里常写纨绔子弟眠花宿柳。
examples.en: Old novels often describe playboys carousing in pleasure quarters.

examples.zh: 父亲痛斥他眠花宿柳，不务正业。
examples.en: His father berated him for dissipation and idleness.

usage.en: Literary and disapproving; 花 and 柳 are old euphemisms for courtesans.
usage.zh: 书面语，含贬义；“花”“柳”是旧时对妓女的代称。

text: 行家一出手，便知有没有
pinyin: háng jia yī chū shǒu, biàn zhī yǒu méi yǒu
literal: expert · once · make move · at once · know · have · not have
natural: the moment an expert moves, you know if he has it

meaning.en: An expert can tell at once whether someone has real skill.
meaning.zh: 内行人一出手，就能看出有没有真本事。

equivalents: it takes one to know one

examples.zh: 行家一出手，便知有没有，他摸了摸瓷器就断定是真品。
examples.en: An expert knows at a touch; he handled the porcelain and declared it genuine.

examples.zh: 行家一出手，便知有没有，教练看了几个动作就知道她有天赋。
examples.en: The expert tells at once; the coach saw a few moves and knew she was gifted.

examples.zh: 别在老师傅面前班门弄斧，行家一出手，便知有没有。
examples.en: Don't show off before the old master; an expert can tell at once.

usage.en: Common in trades, antiques, sport and arts. The saying can be used to praise skill or to size someone up.
usage.zh: 常用于行业、古玩、体育和艺术；既可称赞本领，也可用来判断对方的水平。

synonyms: 内行看门道，外行看热闹

pinyin: zǎi xiàng dù lǐ néng chēng chuán
literal: prime minister · belly · inside · can · pole · boat
natural: a prime minister's belly can punt a boat

meaning.en: A person of high position or character is tolerant and does not hold grudges over small matters.
meaning.zh: 身居高位或胸怀宽广的人，度量大，不计较小事。

examples.zh: 宰相肚里能撑船，您就别和他一般见识了。
examples.en: A great man is generous; please don't take it to heart with him.

examples.zh: 宰相肚里能撑船，领导没有追究这次失误。
examples.en: Magnanimous as ever, the boss let the mistake pass.

examples.zh: 你就大度一点，宰相肚里能撑船嘛。
examples.en: Be generous; the big-hearted forgive small things.

usage.en: Often said to flatter someone into letting it go; a fuller form is 将军额上能跑马，宰相肚里能撑船.
usage.zh: 常用来请人宽宏大量；完整说法是“将军额上能跑马，宰相肚里能撑船”。

natural: calling out threes and shouting fours

meaning.en: To bark orders and shout at people in a domineering way.
meaning.zh: 大声吆喝、指手画脚，形容盛气凌人。

examples.zh: 他在店里呼三喝四，客人都被吓跑了。
examples.en: He barked orders in the shop and scared the customers away.

examples.zh: 别对员工呼三喝四，要尊重别人。
examples.en: Don't shout at your staff; respect others.

examples.zh: 工头呼三喝四，工人们敢怒不敢言。
examples.en: The foreman bullied the men with shouted orders and they dared not complain.

usage.en: Predicate; disapproving. Related 吆五喝六 is a distinct entry, also describing domineering shouting.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，含贬义。与“吆五喝六”相近，二者另作词条。

pinyin: guò yī tiān suàn yī tiān
literal: pass · one · day · count · one · day
natural: count each day as it comes

meaning.en: To live day by day without making plans or effort for the future.
meaning.zh: 不作长远打算，得过且过。

examples.zh: 他对工作没有目标，过一天算一天。
examples.en: He has no goals at work and just drifts along.

examples.zh: 别总是过一天算一天，该为将来打算了。
examples.en: Don't just live day to day; it's time to plan for the future.

examples.zh: 老人觉得日子过一天算一天，不再奢求什么。
examples.en: The old man feels each day is a bonus and wants nothing more.

usage.en: Casual; can be critical (aimlessness) or resigned (living modestly).
usage.zh: 口语，可批评（无目标），也可表示随遇而安的无奈。

natural: not entirely as one would like

meaning.en: Not completely satisfactory; falling short of expectations.
meaning.zh: 不能完全令人满意。

examples.zh: 这次成绩不尽如人意，下次要更努力。
examples.en: The result this time was not entirely satisfactory; I'll try harder next time.

examples.zh: 人生中不尽如人意的事十之八九。
examples.en: Eight or nine times in ten, life does not go as we wish.

examples.zh: 新系统的运行效果不尽如人意。
examples.en: The new system's performance leaves something to be desired.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; a polite, understated way to say something is disappointing.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，是委婉地表示不够理想。

natural: narrow land and crowded people

meaning.en: Little land and many people; overcrowded.
meaning.zh: 土地狭小，人口稠密。

examples.zh: 这座岛屿地狭人稠，每寸土地都很宝贵。
examples.en: The island is small and crowded and every inch of land is precious.

examples.zh: 香港地狭人稠，高楼林立。
examples.en: Hong Kong has little land and a dense population, with towers everywhere.

examples.zh: 地狭人稠的地区，更要重视土地规划。
examples.en: Overcrowded regions need to take land planning even more seriously.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; geographical or demographic description.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，用于地理、人口描述。

natural: lotus flowers coming out of the mouth

meaning.en: To speak so eloquently that it is a joy to hear.
meaning.zh: 说话极其动听、能言善辩。

examples.zh: 他口吐莲花，把客户说得心服口服。
examples.en: He is so eloquent that he talked the client into full agreement.

examples.zh: 这位主持人口吐莲花，现场气氛热烈。
examples.en: The host spoke with such eloquence that the atmosphere was lively.

examples.zh: 别被他口吐莲花的样子骗了。
examples.en: Don't be taken in by his silver tongue.

usage.en: Often combined with 舌灿莲花; the image comes from Buddhist stories in which the Buddha's preaching makes lotus flowers bloom. Sometimes used ironically of a smooth talker.
usage.zh: 常与“舌灿莲花”连用；意象来自佛教故事，佛说法时天降莲花。有时讽刺能说会道的人。

natural: rushing east and dashing west

meaning.en: To charge around in disorder, like fleeing or desperate troops.
meaning.zh: 四处乱冲乱撞，常形容惊慌逃窜或勇猛冲杀。

examples.zh: 受惊的野马在草原上东奔西突。
examples.en: The startled wild horses dashed about the grassland.

examples.zh: 残兵败将东奔西突，找不到出路。
examples.en: The beaten troops rushed about in all directions, finding no way out.

examples.zh: 守门员在禁区里东奔西突，救下了几个险球。
examples.en: The goalkeeper scrambled about the box and saved a few close shots.

usage.en: Predicate; literary; can describe panic or wild energy.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语；可形容惊慌，也可形容勇猛。

natural: give people a handle to talk about

meaning.en: To give others an excuse to criticise or attack.
meaning.zh: 给别人留下了批评或攻击的借口。

equivalents: give people something to talk about

examples.zh: 处理这件事要谨慎，不要落人口实。
examples.en: Handle this carefully, and don't give anyone grounds for criticism.

examples.zh: 他的言行不当，落人口实。
examples.en: His improper words and conduct gave people a pretext.

examples.zh: 为了不落人口实，会议记录必须完整。
examples.en: So as not to give people ammunition, the minutes must be complete.

usage.en: Predicate; usually with 免得 / 以免 / 不要. Warns about leaving a pretext.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“免得”“以免”“不要”连用，提醒不要留下把柄。

natural: troubled times produce heroes

meaning.en: Great figures emerge in times of upheaval.
meaning.zh: 动荡的年代会涌现杰出人物。

equivalents: cometh the hour, cometh the man

examples.zh: 乱世出英雄，三国时期人才辈出。
examples.en: Troubled times make heroes, and talent emerged in droves in the Three Kingdoms.

examples.zh: 他认为乱世出英雄，商业危机反倒给了新人机会。
examples.en: He believes crises produce heroes, and the downturn gave newcomers a chance.

examples.zh: 乱世出英雄，但没有人愿意生在乱世。
examples.en: Troubled times produce heroes, but no one wants to be born into them.

usage.en: Often paired with 时势造英雄; neutral, sometimes with a sense that suffering is the price.
usage.zh: 常与“时势造英雄”并用，中性，有时暗含代价沉重之意。

pinyin: rén shēng zì gǔ shāng lí bié
literal: life · since · ancient times · grieve · parting
natural: since ancient times people have grieved at parting

meaning.en: Partings have always been sad.
meaning.zh: 自古以来，人们都为离别而感伤。

examples.zh: 人生自古伤离别，机场里满是依依不舍的人。
examples.en: Parting has always been sad, and the airport is full of reluctant goodbyes.

examples.zh: 毕业典礼上，大家都感叹人生自古伤离别，眼泪汪汪。
examples.en: At graduation everyone's eyes filled with tears at the familiar sorrow of parting.

examples.zh: 人生自古伤离别，你也别太难过。
examples.en: Parting has always hurt; don't be too sad.

usage.en: Poetic saying often used at farewells; similar to Liu Yong's line 多情自古伤离别 (《雨霖铃》). Its exact source is not firmly established.
usage.zh: 诗意的俗语，常用于送别；与柳永“多情自古伤离别”（《雨霖铃》）相近。确切出处不详。

synonyms: 多情自古伤离别，更那堪冷落清秋节

natural: step down and yield to the worthy

meaning.en: To give up one's post in favour of someone abler.
meaning.zh: 自动让出职位，让给更有才德的人。

equivalents: step down in favour of a better person

examples.zh: 老厂长主动退位让贤，把位子交给年轻人。
examples.en: The old director stepped down of his own accord for a younger man.

examples.zh: 传说尧舜退位让贤，天下为公。
examples.en: Legend has it that Yao and Shun yielded the throne to the worthy, ruling for the public good.

examples.zh: 他觉得自己能力不足，愿意退位让贤。
examples.en: Feeling he lacked ability, he was willing to give way to someone better.

usage.en: Predicate; formal, often admiring. Can be used ironically when someone is pushed out.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语，多含赞许；有时也反语指被迫下台。

literal: roll up like a mat · all · under heaven
natural: roll up the whole world like a mat

meaning.en: To sweep across the whole land, conquering or overwhelming it.
meaning.zh: 像卷席子一样把天下全部占领，形容势力或影响极大。

examples.zh: 秦国席卷天下，终于统一了六国。
examples.en: Qin swept the world and finally united the six states.

examples.zh: 这股流行风潮席卷天下，几乎人人参与。
examples.en: This craze swept the world and nearly everybody joined in.

examples.zh: 起义军席卷天下，朝廷无力抵挡。
examples.en: The rebels swept across the land and the court could not resist.

story.en: Describing the First Emperor's ancestors, Jia Yi wrote that they had 'the intention to roll up the world, embrace all within the universe, bag the four seas and swallow the eight wildernesses'.
story.zh: 贾谊写秦国先人“有席卷天下，包举宇内，囊括四海之意，并吞八荒之心”。

usage.en: Predicate; literary, used for conquest as well as for fashions and movements. The line in the source goes on to 包举宇内，囊括四海，并吞八荒.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语，可用于征服，也可用于潮流、运动。原文接着是“包举宇内，囊括四海，并吞八荒”。

natural: swallow the eight wildernesses

meaning.en: To annex all the lands in every direction; boundless ambition to conquer.
meaning.zh: 吞并天下各个角落，形容野心极大。

examples.zh: 秦孝公有并吞八荒之心，任用商鞅变法。
examples.en: Duke Xiao of Qin harboured a desire to swallow the whole world and employed Shang Yang's reforms.

examples.zh: 他野心勃勃，大有并吞八荒的气概。
examples.en: He is hugely ambitious, with a spirit of conquering the whole world.

examples.zh: 并吞八荒的野心，最终使这个国家走向灭亡。
examples.en: The ambition to swallow the whole world finally led the state to ruin.

story.en: Jia Yi wrote that Qin's rulers had 'the intention to roll up the world, embrace all within the universe, bag the four seas and swallow the eight wildernesses' (并吞八荒之心).
story.zh: 贾谊写秦国先人“有席卷天下，包举宇内，囊括四海之意，并吞八荒之心”。

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; literary. The word order 吞并八荒 also appears but 并吞八荒 is the original and standard form.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，书面语。也有人说“吞并八荒”，但“并吞八荒”是原文和通行写法。

natural: talk through the night by candlelight

meaning.en: To sit up late talking with a close friend.
meaning.zh: 点着蜡烛，通宵长谈。

equivalents: burn the midnight oil in conversation

examples.zh: 老友重逢，秉烛夜谈，不觉天已大亮。
examples.en: Old friends reunited and talked all night until the day broke.

examples.zh: 我们秉烛夜谈，聊起了少年时的往事。
examples.en: We sat up talking by candlelight about boyhood memories.

examples.zh: 导师与学生秉烛夜谈，探讨学术问题。
examples.en: The mentor and student talked late into the night over academic questions.

usage.en: Predicate; warm and literary, evoking close friendship. Distinct from 秉烛夜游 (enjoy life while one can).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，温馨文雅，多指知己长谈；与表示及时行乐的“秉烛夜游”不同。
